text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Even a little is fine. I'll change it! 
I'm going to change it!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The REAL me is...! HAAAAAHHHHHHââ!!

Mejiro Palmer gave it everything she had, 
but victory in the Satsuki Sho was not to 
be.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp, wheeze, gasp, gasp*... No 
more~. Right now... I can't run any more 
than this...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Palmer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Palmer. How should I put it... 
Palmer, you're really something else...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Did something change? She seems so 
serious... or should I say, kind of 
terrifying?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Scared?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. You never made such a stern face 
when we were kids, did you?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So I wondered if that's what changed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, maybe. Even so..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Sorry, it's not that I've changed or 
anything. It's just that~)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(I just couldn't show my true self for the 
longest time. And now, at last, just a 
little bit...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm back, Trainer! I gave it everything I 
had, so I feel refreshed, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I guess I couldn't really change the way 
people see Ryan. It's pretty hard to break 
out of that "good kid" role, huh.
choice_data_list: Still, didn't you leave your mark?
Still, didn't you leave your mark?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. I felt like Ryan's eyes changed for 
a second. Like, 'Not bad, kid.'"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I gotta become able to convey them way 
more! ――My vibes, that is.

A scene from childhood. A sepia-toned 
memory etched into the mind: "Mejiro 
Palmer is a good girl."

It felt as though, today, Mejiro Palmer 
had managed to change that color just a 
little bit.
